_edition: ADVANCED-EDITION-CODE: in the advanced edition's archive, never the standard one's.
field.instead: What the standard edition does instead
statement.start_with_codex.does: Starts the watcher when Codex starts, even inside the job Codex closes when it quits. With this on and no watcher running, it asks Windows (WMI) to start the watcher outside that job, so it keeps running after Codex closes. It registers nothing.
statement.start_with_codex.instead: The standard edition starts nothing here: where Codex would end the watcher it writes one line to say so and waits for you to start the watcher yourself once Codex has closed.
statement.start_with_codex.departs: C4 (the product starts nothing on its own when Codex starts) and F6 (it adds one process-creation route, through WMI, beyond the ones the standard edition uses).
statement.start_with_codex.risks: Its only purpose is to leave a limit Codex places on its plugins on purpose. If WMI is off, or a policy blocks process creation through it, nothing starts and the reason is logged; you are never asked to change that policy. It starts the watcher and nothing else, keeps every recovery gate, and never starts a second copy.
statement.start_with_codex.stop: Turn it off in the Dashboard, or turn off every advanced feature at once. It never starts a second watcher while one is running, and it only ever starts this installation's own launcher.
warning.title: Warnings
warning.note: None of these stops you turning it on. Turning it on confirms you have read them, and if a new problem appears later, it turns itself off.
warning.measurement_failed: A measurement of what it relies on failed. It may not work with your Codex.
warning.unmeasured: What it relies on has not been measured with this version of Codex.
warning.failed_here: A compatibility check of what it relies on failed on this computer.
warning.incompatible: The compatibility data says what it relies on does not work with this version of Codex.
warning.local_check_failed: A check on this computer found that this version of Codex lacks what it relies on.
warning.compat_unknown: It is not known whether what it relies on works with this version of Codex.
warning.engine_unknown: The version of Codex is not known yet. If you turn it on, it turns off again once the version is known, so that you can confirm that version.
